## Visteon To Announce Third Quarter 2026 Results on October 22


10/13/2026


[Download (opens in new window) PDF 109 KB](https://s205.q4cdn.com/875277771/files/doc_news/Visteon-To-Announce-Third-Quarter-2026-Results-on-October-22-2026.pdf)


VAN BUREN TOWNSHIP, Mich.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Visteon Corporation (NASDAQ: VC), a global leader in automotive cockpit electronics, will release its third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Thursday, October 22. The Company will host a conference call for the investment community at 9 a.m. ET to discuss the results and related matters. The conference call is also available to the public via live[audio webcast](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796443-1&h=1092032167&u=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F257149910&a=audio%C2%A0webcast) .


The dial-in numbers to participate in the call are:


- U.S./Canada Participants Toll-Free Dial-In Number: 1-833-461-5787
- International Participants Toll Dial-In Number: 1-585-542-9983
- Conference ID: 257149910


(Dial-in approximately 10 minutes before the start of the conference.)


The conference call and live audio webcast, related presentation materials, news release and other supplemental information will be accessible in the[Investors](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796443-1&h=323087353&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.visteon.com%2Finvestors%2Finvestor-overview%2F&a=Investors) section of Visteon's website. Shortly after the call, a replay of the webcast will be available on the Company's website.


**About Visteon**
Visteon (NASDAQ: VC) is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software-defined future. The Company's state-of-the-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two-wheelers, Visteon partners with global OEMs to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. For more information, visit[visteon.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4796443-1&h=3075692417&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.visteon.com%2F&a=visteon.com) .
